sig: [[["A", "Good afternoon, everyone. This is Tom from the IT operations team with a quick announcement."], ["A", "This Saturday, we'll be carrying out planned maintenance on our main database servers."], ["A", "The work will start at ten p.m. on Saturday and should be finished by six a.m. on Sunday."], ["A", "During that time, the customer portal and the internal HR system will be unavailable."], ["A", "E-mail and chat won't be affected, so you can still contact each other as usual."], ["A", "If you're on call this weekend, please note that alerts will be paused for the duration of the maintenance."], ["A", "Before you leave on Friday, make sure you save any open work and log out of all internal tools."], ["A", "Anything left unsaved may be lost when the servers restart."], ["A", "We'll send a confirmation e-mail as soon as everything is back online."], ["A", "And if you notice any problems on Sunday morning, please submit a ticket through the help desk rather than messaging the team directly."], ["A", "That way, we can track and prioritize issues more efficiently."], ["A", "Thanks for your patience, and have a great weekend."]], {"A": "M-GB"}]
